title: Trivial Trait Implementation Doc-Comments
pattern: Doc-comments on standard language trait implementations (like Clone, Debug, Display) repeating the trait's basic action.
why_bad: Noise clutter. The semantic meaning of standard traits is globally known. Trivial comments restating standard operations waste reader scan time and offer no custom module-level context.
detection: Doc-comments on functions implementing standard traits, containing only a repeat of the trait's name.
counterexample: A trait impl doc-comment describing genuinely custom semantics, e.g. a `Display` impl that masks account numbers for security.
source: Kent Beck, *Tidy First?* (2023), Chapter 15 ("Delete Redundant Comments").
